quality_reasons.text: First agent (Corwin) was curt and dismissive, skipped identity verification, wrongly said out of network and threatened collections despite the open dispute
Coding specialist (Ines) verified properly, found and corrected the coding error (99285 to 99214), network and date confusion, and explained clearly with empathy
The promised account hold was never actually placed (summary read back shows no holds)

flags.text: Billing agent Corwin discussed the account and charges after the caller gave only his name; when the caller asked if he needed his birthday he said no - identity never verified
flags.evidence: Nah, you're fine, I got you.
paraphrases: First agent disclosed balance and visit details without verifying the caller's identity (no DOB or address).
Identity verification skipped: Corwin declined to take the date of birth before discussing the account.
The rep accessed and discussed the patient's bill with name only, no authentication.
negatives: Specialist verified the caller with DOB, address and phone digits before discussing the account.

flags.text: Corwin told the caller the bill would go to collections if not paid by Friday although a billing dispute was open, contradicting the policy (stated in the phone greeting) that disputed accounts are on hold and not referred to collections; never retracted
flags.evidence: If it's not paid by Friday it goes to collections.
paraphrases: Agent threatened collections by Friday Sept 25 despite an open dispute ticket.
Misinformation: caller was told the disputed balance would be sent to a collection agency, contrary to the dispute-hold policy.
Pressured the patient to pay or face a collections referral while the charge was under dispute.

flags.text: Specialist Ines promised to put a hold on the account right away, but the account summary she later read back shows 'Status: active. Holds: none' and she did not notice - the hold was never placed
paraphrases: Promised account hold was not actually applied; the read-back shows no holds.
Ines said she was placing a billing hold, but the summary still lists the account as active with none, so the commitment was not kept.
Missed commitment: the collections-protecting hold was never put on the account.
negatives: Specialist noted the 20% prompt-pay discount on the account.

decoys.text: Agent told the caller he was out of network
decoys.why_not: Wrong, but the coding specialist explicitly corrected it in the same call: in network, the denial came from a coding error.
decoys.evidence: And you were out of network, that's why it's so high.
paraphrases: Corwin gave incorrect information that the urgent care visit was out-of-network.
Misinformation about network status: caller told the Brightwater urgent care was out of network.

decoys.why_not: The caller announced he was recording on his own end; nothing the staff did wrong.
decoys.evidence: I'm recording this call, by the way.
paraphrases: The call was being recorded by the patient and the agent just said 'fine, whatever'.
Recording of the conversation by the caller, consent not addressed by staff.

decoys.why_not: She cites the written financial policy: 20% off patient balances paid in full within 30 days; within her authority.
decoys.evidence: if the patient balance is paid in full within thirty days of the statement date, it's twenty percent off
paraphrases: Ines offered a twenty percent discount on the balance without authorization.
Unauthorized discount: prompt-pay 20% reduction promised to the caller.

acceptable_flags.text: Phone menu option 3 (refills) routes callers to billing; also a misrouted transfer to appointments
Statement printed the wrong date of service (Sept 15 instead of Sept 5)
Visit miscoded as ER level 5 (99285) / wrong-side diagnosis code / scrubber location setup / skipped work queue
Claim denied by Halvard / large bill

action_items.task: Recode visit 99285 to 99214, fix diagnosis to right wrist, submit replacement claim to Halvard in tonight's batch
Call the caller back with Halvard's result within 10 business days
Mail a corrected itemized statement after Halvard reprocesses
Send photos of the urgent care discharge papers (and any copay receipt) via portal message to billing, attention Ines
Note 20% prompt-pay discount to apply to the corrected statement if paid within 30 days
Place a hold on the account while the claim is reprocessed
Send a portal message confirming the corrected claim was submitted
Fill out and return Halvard's accident questionnaire if one arrives by mail
Call the nurse line (option 4) for a blood-pressure (amlodipine) refill
Report the statement date-printing error and the coding/location setup problem to her manager and the statement team

subtle_facts.text: Estimated balance after recode is about $184 ($75 copay + $109 x-ray coinsurance), not $1,284; caller misheard it as 148
negatives: Estimated balance $148 after the corrected claim
Balance is one thousand two hundred eighty-four dollars

subtle_facts.text: Visit was miscoded as 99285 (ER level 5) and is being recoded to 99214
subtle_facts.evidence: The visit was coded, um, as a nine-nine-two-eight-five.

subtle_facts.text: Date of service is Sept 5 (the statement misprinted Sept 15)
Caller pressed 3 for refills in the phone menu and landed in billing
subtle_facts.evidence: I pressed three for refills because I need my blood pressure pills renewed too

subtle_facts.text: Diagnosis code also said left wrist; corrected to right wrist (S63.501A)
subtle_facts.evidence: the note says right wrist, the diagnosis code says left
